### Module 02 — Capstone · End-to-End EDA on Readmission Risk

# Capstone · End-to-End EDA on Readmission Risk

***
**This capstone integrates NB-01 through NB-07 into a single reproducible EDA pipeline.**

**Deliverables**
1. Automated data quality report (DataExplorer / skimr)
2. Table 1 — baseline characteristics by readmission status
3. Time-trend of readmissions 2019–2023
4. Comorbidity co-occurrence analysis
5. Missingness audit and imputation plan
6. Geospatial hotspot summary
7. Multi-panel EDA summary figure
8. Written analytic narrative

**Estimated time:** 4 hours | **Level:** Advanced | **Libraries:** all MOD-02 libraries

## 0. Analysis Plan

**Research question:** What patient, clinical, and area-level factors are associated with 30-day hospital readmission?

**Analytic steps:**
1. Load and profile data → flag quality issues
2. Describe cohort (Table 1) stratified by readmission status
3. Explore temporal trends in readmission rates
4. Map comorbidity burden and co-occurrence patterns
5. Characterise and document missingness; choose imputation
6. Map geographic clustering of readmission risk
7. Synthesise findings in a multi-panel figure
8. Draft analytic narrative for a methods section

> **Reproducibility:** Set a global random seed; document all decisions in markdown cells.

## 1. Setup & Data Assembly


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(lubridate)
library(scales)
library(naniar)
library(skimr)
library(DataExplorer)
library(mice)
library(ranger)
library(pROC)
library(sf)

SEED <- 42
set.seed(SEED)

mod02_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "mod02")
dir.create(mod02_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

theme_health <- function(base_size = 12) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
    )
}
theme_set(theme_health())

skewness <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  n <- length(x)
  m <- mean(x)
  s <- sd(x)
  if (n < 3 || s == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mean((x - m)^3) / (s^3)
}

logistic <- function(x) plogis(x)

# ── Full capstone dataset ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
N <- 1000
ages      <- as.integer(pmin(pmax(rnorm(N, 62, 16), 18), 95))
sexes     <- sample(c("M", "F"), N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.48, 0.52))
payers    <- sample(c("Medicare", "Medicaid", "Private", "Self-pay", "Other"),
                    N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.40, 0.22, 0.28, 0.07, 0.03))
drg_codes <- sample(c(470, 291, 392, 690, 871, 193, 247, 603), N, replace = TRUE)
drg_labels_map <- c(
  `470` = "Major joint replacement", `291` = "Heart failure & shock",
  `392` = "Esophagitis/misc GI",     `690` = "Kidney/UTI",
  `871` = "Septicemia",              `193` = "Simple pneumonia",
  `247` = "Perc cardiovasc w stent", `603` = "Cellulitis"
)
los_days <- as.integer(pmin(pmax(rgamma(N, shape = 2.5, scale = 1.8), 1), 30))
charges  <- round(los_days * runif(N, 1800, 4200), 2)
set.seed(99)
base <- matrix(rnorm(N * 3), ncol = 3)
diabetes      <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.6 * base[, 1] - 0.5))
hypertension  <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.7 * base[, 1] + 0.3 * base[, 2] - 0.2))
obesity       <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.5 * base[, 1] + 0.4 * base[, 2] - 0.8))
ckd           <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.5 * base[, 1] + 0.6 * diabetes - 1.2))
heart_failure <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.4 * base[, 2] + 0.5 * hypertension - 1.5))
copd          <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.5 * base[, 3] - 1.0))
n_comorbidities <- diabetes + hypertension + obesity + ckd + heart_failure + copd
readmit_logit <- -2.5 + 0.4 * heart_failure + 0.3 * ckd +
  0.2 * (n_comorbidities / 6) + 0.3 * (los_days > 7) + 0.2 * (payers == "Medicaid")
readmitted_30 <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(readmit_logit))
admit_type <- sample(c("Emergency", "Elective", "Urgent", "Newborn"),
                     N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.52, 0.30, 0.16, 0.02))
set.seed(21)
glucose    <- round(pmin(pmax(rnorm(N, 105, 28), 50), 400), 1)
creatinine <- round(pmin(pmax(rgamma(N, shape = 1.6, scale = 0.6), 0.4), 10), 2)
hba1c      <- round(pmin(pmax(rnorm(N, 6.8, 1.4), 4), 14), 1)

# Structured missingness
glucose[runif(N) < 0.08] <- NA_real_
creatinine[(payers == "Self-pay") & (runif(N) < 0.50)] <- NA_real_
creatinine[(payers != "Self-pay") & (runif(N) < 0.09)] <- NA_real_
charges[runif(N) < 0.07] <- NA_real_

start <- as.Date("2019-01-01")
set.seed(5)
n_days <- as.integer(as.Date("2023-12-31") - start)
admit_dates <- start + sample(0:(n_days - 1), N, replace = TRUE)

# ZIP codes (50 areas)
zip_codes  <- sprintf("%05d", 10000 + sample(0:49, N, replace = TRUE))
svi_by_zip <- setNames(rbeta(50, 2, 3), sprintf("%05d", 10000 + 0:49))
svi_scores <- unname(svi_by_zip[zip_codes])

df <- tibble(
  patient_id      = sprintf("PT-%05d", seq_len(N)),
  age             = ages,
  sex             = sexes,
  payer           = payers,
  drg_code        = drg_codes,
  drg_label       = unname(drg_labels_map[as.character(drg_codes)]),
  admit_type      = admit_type,
  los_days        = los_days,
  total_charge    = charges,
  diabetes        = diabetes,
  hypertension    = hypertension,
  obesity         = obesity,
  ckd             = ckd,
  heart_failure   = heart_failure,
  copd            = copd,
  n_comorbidities = n_comorbidities,
  glucose         = glucose,
  creatinine      = creatinine,
  hba1c           = hba1c,
  readmitted_30   = readmitted_30,
  admit_date      = as.Date(admit_dates),
  zip             = zip_codes,
  svi             = svi_scores
)
df$age_group   <- cut(df$age, breaks = c(17, 44, 64, 74, 95),
                      labels = c("18-44", "45-64", "65-74", "75+"))
df$admit_year  <- year(df$admit_date)
df$admit_month <- floor_date(df$admit_date, "month")

cat(sprintf("Capstone dataset: %d x %d\n", nrow(df), ncol(df)))
```

## 3. Step 2 — Table 1

```{.r .cell-code}
wilson_ci <- function(k, n, alpha = 0.05) {
  z <- qnorm(1 - alpha / 2); p <- k / n; den <- 1 + z^2 / n
  mid <- (p + z^2 / (2 * n)) / den
  hw  <- (z * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z^2 / (4 * n^2))) / den
  c(round((mid - hw) * 100, 1), round((mid + hw) * 100, 1))
}
```

## 4. Step 3 — Temporal Trends in Readmissions


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
monthly_read <- df %>%
  count(date = floor_date(admit_date, "month"), wt = NULL, name = "n_discharge") %>%
  left_join(
    df %>%
      group_by(date = floor_date(admit_date, "month")) %>%
      summarise(n_readmit = sum(readmitted_30), .groups = "drop"),
    by = "date"
  ) %>%
  complete(date = seq(min(date), max(date), by = "month"),
           fill = list(n_discharge = 0, n_readmit = 0)) %>%
  mutate(
    rate      = if_else(n_discharge > 0, n_readmit / n_discharge * 100, NA_real_),
    roll_rate = as.numeric(stats::filter(rate, rep(1 / 3, 3), sides = 2))
  )

p_vol <- ggplot(monthly_read, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = n_discharge), fill = "#AEC6CF", width = 20) +
  geom_line(aes(y = n_readmit * (max(n_discharge) / max(pmax(n_readmit, 1)))),
            colour = "#DC2626", linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "N discharges",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * max(monthly_read$n_readmit) / max(monthly_read$n_discharge),
                        name = "N readmissions")
  ) +
  labs(title = "Monthly volume", x = NULL) +
  theme_health() +
  theme(axis.title.y.right = element_text(colour = "#DC2626"))

p_rate <- ggplot(monthly_read, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = rate), colour = "#B0C4DE", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(aes(y = roll_rate), colour = "#1F4E79", linewidth = 1.1, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(monthly_read$rate, na.rm = TRUE),
             colour = "#DC2626", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "4 months", date_labels = "%Y-%m") +
  labs(y = "30-day readmission rate (%)", x = "Admission month",
       title = "Readmission rate trend",
       caption = sprintf("Overall mean (%.1f%%); navy = 3-month rolling mean",
                         mean(monthly_read$rate, na.rm = TRUE))) +
  theme_health() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

p_temp <- p_vol / p_rate +
  plot_annotation(title = "Temporal trends in hospital readmissions (2019–2023)")
print(p_temp)
```

## 5. Step 4 — Comorbidity Analysis


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
COMORBS <- c("diabetes", "hypertension", "obesity", "ckd", "heart_failure", "copd")

phi_coeff <- function(a, b) {
  ct <- table(a, b)
  if (!all(dim(ct) == c(2, 2))) return(0)
  n    <- sum(ct)
  chi2 <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(ct)$statistic)
  sgn  <- sign(ct[2, 2] * ct[1, 1] - ct[1, 2] * ct[2, 1])
  as.numeric(sqrt(unname(chi2) / n) * sgn)
}

phi_m <- matrix(NA_real_, length(COMORBS), length(COMORBS),
                dimnames = list(COMORBS, COMORBS))
for (c1 in COMORBS) {
  for (c2 in COMORBS) {
    phi_m[c1, c2] <- phi_coeff(df[[c1]], df[[c2]])
  }
}

phi_heat <- as.data.frame(as.table(phi_m), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
names(phi_heat) <- c("cond_1", "cond_2", "phi")

p_phi <- ggplot(phi_heat, aes(x = cond_1, y = cond_2, fill = phi)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
```

```{.r .cell-code}
miss_cols <- c("glucose", "creatinine", "hba1c", "total_charge")
for (col in miss_cols) {
  pct <- mean(is.na(df[[col]])) * 100
  miss_flag <- as.integer(is.na(df[[col]]))

  cat(sprintf("%-20s: %5.1f%% missing | χ²-payer p=%.3f → %s\n",
              col, pct, p, mechanism))
```

## 9. Analytic Narrative Draft

> **Methods (EDA section)**
>
> We conducted a comprehensive EDA of a synthetic hospital discharge cohort (N = 1,000) spanning 2019–2023. Continuous variables were summarised as mean ± SD or median [IQR] based on Shapiro-Wilk skewness assessment; categorical variables as N (%). Group comparisons used Mann-Whitney U tests for skewed continuous outcomes and chi-square tests for categorical variables.
>
> Data quality assessment identified missing values in four variables: creatinine (high missingness in Self-pay patients, consistent with MAR mechanism), glucose (random, MCAR pattern), total charges, and HbA1c. All missing values were imputed using MICE (10 iterations, median initial strategy) with payer type included as an auxiliary variable.
>
> Comorbidity co-occurrence was assessed using pairwise phi coefficients with hierarchical Ward clustering. A 10-condition network was constructed at a phi threshold of 0.15.
>
> Geographic analysis aggregated 1,000 discharges to 50 ZIP code areas (minimum 5 discharges). Area-level readmission rates were correlated with CDC Social Vulnerability Index scores using Spearman rank correlation. A temporal decomposition of monthly admission counts used an additive seasonal model with a 12-month period.
>
> All analyses were conducted in R 4.3+ using dplyr / tibble, stats, ggplot2, and tidymodels. Code and datasets are available at [GitHub repository].

```{.r .cell-code}
FEATURES <- c("age", "los_days", "n_comorbidities", "diabetes", "hypertension",
              "ckd", "heart_failure", "copd")
TARGET   <- "readmitted_30"

set.seed(SEED)
model_df <- df_imp %>%
  select(all_of(c(FEATURES, TARGET))) %>%
  mutate(readmitted_30 = factor(readmitted_30, levels = c(0, 1),
                                labels = c("no", "yes")))

n <- nrow(model_df)
train_idx <- sample(seq_len(n), size = floor(0.8 * n))
train <- model_df[train_idx, ]
test  <- model_df[-train_idx, ]

rf <- ranger(
  formula     = readmitted_30 ~ .,
  data        = train,
  probability = TRUE,
  num.trees   = 100,
  importance  = "impurity",
  seed        = SEED
)
pred <- predict(rf, test)$predictions[, "yes"]
auc  <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(test$readmitted_30, pred, quiet = TRUE))
cat(sprintf("Quick Random Forest AUC (before tuning): %.3f\n", auc))
```
